description:

description:
Greys Specialist Recruitment are working with an established business to recruit a Supply Chain & Procurement Co-Ordinator to join its purchasing team at its site in Carrington, Trafford.

Reporting to the Group Purchasing Manager, this is a varied role combining purchasing, supplier management and day-to-day supply chain coordination. You will play an important part in ensuring materials and services are available when needed, deliveries arrive on time and stock levels are maintained to support business operations.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous purchasing or supply chain experience who enjoys working with suppliers, solving problems and keeping processes running efficiently within a manufacturing or similar environment.

The Role

Working closely with the Purchasing Manager and teams across the business, your responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating the purchasing of raw materials, consumables and services to meet operational and production requirements.
- Obtaining supplier quotations, reviewing pricing and delivery timescales, and supporting negotiations to secure competitive terms.
- Building and maintaining effective relationships with suppliers, monitoring service levels and helping to resolve delivery, quality and pricing issues.
- Monitoring stock levels and material availability to support production schedules and minimise shortages or excess inventory.
- Liaising with suppliers, logistics partners, warehouse and production teams to coordinate deliveries and resolve stock discrepancies.
- Supporting demand planning and forecasting to ensure purchasing activity aligns with business requirements.
- Maintaining accurate purchasing, supplier and stock records using internal systems and Microsoft Excel.
- Preparing reports on purchasing activity, stock levels and supplier performance, highlighting potential issues and opportunities for improvement.
- Supporting supplier approval processes and maintaining documentation in line with company procedures and ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 requirements.
- Contributing to cost-saving initiatives, waste reduction and continuous improvement projects.
- Assisting with ERP/MRP system improvements and ensuring purchasing processes remain accurate and efficient.
- Supporting internal and external audits, attending meetings and undertaking occasional UK or international supplier visits where required.

About You

We are looking for an organised and commercially minded individual with previous experience in purchasing, procurement or supply chain coordination, ideally within a manufacturing, engineering or similar operational environment.

You will be comfortable managing multiple priorities, communicating with suppliers and internal departments, and taking a proactive approach to resolving issues.

You should also have:
- Experience in purchasing, supplier coordination or supply chain operations.
- A good understanding of procurement processes, stock control and delivery coordination.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, with the ability to maintain and interpret data accurately.
- Experience using an ERP, MRP or purchasing system.
- Good communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to organise your workload effectively.
- A practical approach to continuous improvement and cost efficiency.

Knowledge of Incoterms and experience supporting ISO compliance or supplier audits would be advantageous. A relevant qualification, such as CIPS or a degree in procurement or supply chain management, would also be beneficial but is not essential.

The Opportunity

This is a great opportunity to join an established business in a varied purchasing and supply chain role, working closely with an experienced Group Purchasing Manager and contributing to the smooth running of day-to-day operations.

The position offers a salary of 29,500 per annum + Bonus, a permanent contract and a Monday-to-Friday working pattern, with an earlier finish on Fridays.

advertiser_name: Greater Manchester Mental Health NHS Foundation Trust
description: At GMMH we are investing significantly into our Community Mental Health provision. An exiting opportunity to join this friendly and welcoming community team based at Woodlands hospital in Little Hulton supporting the Memory Assessment and Treatment Service within our Later Life Services. The Team Administrator will be responsible for providing a comprehensive and confidential administrative support to the clinical team and team manager. The post holder will provide an administrative function to the multi-disciplinary team, minute taking of meetings, typing of clinical correspondence, filing and other general administrative duties. To arrange appointments with service users using the clinics models and to ensure all clinics have appropriate staff cover. Typing of all clinical correspondence Coordinating and directing service user contact via telephone call, email or letter. Identifying priority contact, particularly from distressed service users or relative, informing the relevant team member for the need for urgency when appropriate. Greeting service users, carers and other visitors when required. For full details of this role please see the job description and personal specification. Please see job description and person spec Staff benefits Pay Enhancements 30% additional for Evenings (8pm onwards) and Saturdays and 60% additional for Sundays and Bank holidays. 27 days annual leave plus bank holidays rising to 29 after 5 years and 33 days after 10 years Excellent pension Cycle to work scheme Salary sacrifice car scheme Wellbeing programme Blue Light Card Discounts

title: Senior Receptionist
description: We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Receptionist to join our busy GP practice. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and patient-focused individual to play a key role in supporting the smooth running of our reception team and delivering exceptional customer service to our patients. Acting as a senior member of the reception team and providing day-to-day support to reception staff. Managing and resolving patient queries, concerns, and complaints in a professional and empathetic manner. Providing excellent customer service both face-to-face and over the telephone. Scheduling appointments and assisting patients with access to practice services. Supporting the management of staff rotas, including adding schedules and maintaining rotas within EMIS Web. Assisting with practice administration and ensuring reception processes are followed efficiently. Working collaboratively with clinical and administrative teams to support patient care. Maintaining patient confidentiality at all times in line with NHS and GDPR requirements The Senior Receptionist plays a key role in supporting the day-to-day management of the reception function, ensuring that patients receive a professional, efficient, and welcoming service at all times. As a senior member of the administrative team, you will provide guidance and support to reception staff, assist with the smooth running of practice operations, and help maintain high standards of patient care. The role involves managing patient enquiries and resolving issues effectively, coordinating appointments, maintaining staff rotas and schedules within EMIS Web, and supporting the delivery of administrative processes across the practice. You will work closely with clinicians, management, and administrative colleagues to ensure services are delivered efficiently and in line with practice policies, NHS requirements, and patient needs. The successful candidate will possess excellent communication, organisational, and problem-solving skills, with experience in a GP practice environment and a commitment to providing outstanding patient service. Knowledge of EMIS Web and an understanding of QOF processes are highly desirable. All duties must be carried out with strict adherence to patient confidentiality, GDPR requirements, and NHS standards.
